A [[Chiss officer/Legends|Chiss officer's]] '''long tunic''' was a variant of the [[Defense Fleet uniform]]. Unlike the standard Defense Fleet uniform, the tunic was loose-fitting, more elaborate, and less functional and was comparable to the [[Chiss robes of state|robes of state]]. It was predominantly colored [[Color/Legends|black]], with swatches on the sleeves and upper shoulders in the color of one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]].<ref name="SQ" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Prard'ras'kleoni]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Drask," of the [[Chiss Defense Fleet]] wore a long black tunic with swatches of dusky red on the sleeves and upper shoulders. In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Chiss [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brast'alshi'barku]], core name "Talshib," wore a similar outfit to General Drask but with green patches instead.<ref name="SQ" />

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Chiss officer's long tunic first appeared in the [[2004]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" />
